prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original editorial architectural photograph for BloqIA, a Spanish thinking and AI chat application.
Primary request: a peaceful study in a contemporary concrete building, a very simple desk with a notebook and open books beside a tall window, hard sunlight creating one large diagonal across a pale warm wall. A single ultramarine-blue seat and one soft-lime book are the restrained color accents.
Scene/backdrop: quiet sophisticated architectural interior with textured concrete, a pale paper-tone wall, a tall window and generous negative space.
Style/medium: sophisticated architectural photography, subtle analog grain, real natural materials, tactile and calm, editorial quality.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 aspect ratio. Wide enough to show the room, simple desk and single chair. Use generous negative space, the diagonal sunlight is an important compositional element. A calm composition that expresses pause, judgment and human decisions.
Lighting/mood: strong natural sunlight entering from the tall window, a deliberate broad diagonal of light and shadow on the pale wall, quiet and contemplative.
Color palette: graphite #18252B, pale warm paper #F4F3EE, ultramarine #244ADA on the single chair, soft lime #DAED9E on one book.
Materials/textures: real concrete, uncoated paper, matte surfaces, natural shadows.
Constraints: no people. No legible text, no logos, no watermarks. This is a photograph only, not a page layout or interface composition.
Avoid: neon, futuristic decor, screens, computers, robots, glowing effects, circuits, brain imagery, excessive decoration or clutter.
visual_review: 1024 x 1536, portrait 2:3. Quiet contemporary concrete study with tall window, long minimal desk, open book and notebook, single ultramarine chair, pale lime book and large diagonal sunlight. No people, branding, legible text or futuristic imagery.
